statement: Combined hyperscaler capex is guided to $660-690 billion in 2026 with about 75% directed at AI infrastructure, and Meta alone carries $115-135 billion of 2026 capex guidance - a large forward-demand backdrop.
why: Very large AI-directed hyperscaler capex sustains forward demand across accelerators, datacenter capacity, and power.

impact.mechanism: $660-690B in 2026 hyperscaler capex, 75% AI-directed, funds continued large-scale purchases of accelerators, datacenter build-out, and power.

evidence.excerpt: Combined hyperscaler capital expenditure reaches $660 to $690 billion in 2026, with 75% directed at AI-specific infrastructure
Meta alone carries $115 to $135 billion in 2026 capital expenditure guidance.

confidence.basis: Secondary opinion/analysis (faf.ae); single publisher, capped at medium.
